summary: 30-year-old Boulder County man fell 50+ ft down a rock wall while retrieving a dropped phone case from a ledge; stopped by a tree ~2:30 p.m.; full multi-agency technical rope rescue across the creek; non-life-threatening right shoulder injury
location: Boulder Canyon, across the creek from Boulder Falls (Tornnere climbing tower)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Nederland Police; AMR; Boulder Emergency Squad Dive Team; Boulder Fire; Sugarloaf Fire
notes: Story footer confirms originally published in the June 1, 2017 print edition
